title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-03-20
lineage: SBD > MR > PCM > ZA2 > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Strong performance highlighted by a killer first half and a smoking electric second set, captured on a mixed‑quality audience recording.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the energy of this show – opening with a thunderous Casey Jones, soaring through China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider, and delivering a triple‑decked Good Lovin'/Not Fade Away/drums sequence that leads into a scorching Viola Lee Blues, heartfelt High Times, solid Lovelight and an extended We Bid You Goodnight.  The recording is a patchwork of audience (AUD) sources: most sections are clear and atmospheric, though the first few tracks suffer from lower fidelity and occasional level shifts.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is consistently praised across multiple reviews while recording quality is noted as uneven, yielding an overall rating just below four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mostly clear audience (AUD) tape with good atmosphere; first five tracks are lower‑fidelity and there are noticeable mic/level changes when the band switches to acoustic, leading to occasional muddiness.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set opens explosively with Casey Jones, flows through classic pairings and a powerful electric second half that builds from Good Lovin'/NFA/drums into a fiery Viola Lee Blues and closes with an extended We Bid You Goodnight.
